tut.swap:
Line up 3 of the same picture to pop them!
Slide a tile into its neighbor to swap
tut.goal:
The numbers by the pictures up top are your goals.
When they're all ✓, you've cleared the stage
tut.moves:
The yellow note shows moves left.
Finish the goals before they run out!
tut.eraser:
Match 4 in a row to make an Eraser.
Swipe it to wipe out a whole line
tut.pushpin_crayon:
L or T shapes make a Pushpin, 5 makes a Crayon!
Swap two items together for a bigger blast
tut.paper_plane:
Match a 2×2 square for a Paper Plane!
It flies off to hit obstacles first
tut.stars:
Finish early and leftover moves become bonus points.
Go for 3 stars!
tut.battle:
It's a raid! Pop tiles and
that tile's friend hits the scribbles
tut.battle_counter:
When the number under a scribble hits 0, it attacks.
Tap a scribble to hit that one first
tut.skill:
When a friend's gauge fills up,
tap them to use a skill!
tut.attr:
Blaze beats Sprout, Sprout beats Wave, Wave beats Blaze.
Sunbeam and Moonshade beat each other
tut.buddy:
Every stage has a buddy.
Bring them along for extra moves
tut.timed:
It's a test stage! Time ticks instead of moves.
Match fast!
tut.crumbs:
Match next to eraser crumbs to sweep them away.
Big crumbs take two hits!
tut.sticky: Match next to sticky notes to peel them one by one
tut.ink:
Ink spreads if you leave it alone!
Hit at least one each turn
tut.tape:
Taped tiles can't move.
Match them to pop the tape off
tut.highlighter:
Match a line that touches a highlighted cell to color it.
Color the whole board!
tut.deliver:
Bring the parcel all the way down!
Pop the tiles under it
tut.hearts:
Leave a stage without clearing it and you lose a heart.
Hearts refill one every 20 minutes
tut.friends:
Clearing stages gives friend shards.
Use shards and coins to upgrade
tut.recruit: Collect treats to invite new friends
tut.gacha:
Spend coins on capsules to meet friends.
If you already have them, you get shards
tut.guild:
This is the company's home.
Each piece of furniture you place wipes away a scribble mark
tut.guild_friends:
Put friends in a room and give them a tap.
When you're close, they bring gifts
tut.missions:
Today's jobs are pinned on the Request Board.
Finish them for rewards!

ui.bestiary.title: Scribble Guide
enemy.e01.desc: A minion made of tangled pencil lines. Erases right off.
enemy.e02.desc: A droopy zigzag line. Its yawns make friends drowsy.
enemy.e03.desc: A spiky ball scratched in ballpoint. Won't erase, sadly.
enemy.e04.desc: A dripping ink leech that sucks up gauges.
enemy.e05.desc: A cloud doodled over in ballpoint. Just being near it is sleepy.
enemy.e06.desc: A snail with a whiteout shell. It patches other scribbles back up.
enemy.e07.desc: A toadstool with highlighter spots. Its spores are poisonous.
enemy.e08.desc: A snapping stapler. When it stomps, the board shuffles.
enemy.e09.desc: Eight rusty paper-clip legs. Saps your strength.
enemy.e10.desc: A hatched ballpoint octopus. Spits ink all over the board.
enemy.e11.desc: An Inkcrow grunt with an ink barrel. Swipes shiny items.
enemy.e12.desc: White hood, eraser staff. Wipes away your buffs.
enemy.boss.kkobul_king.title: King of the Squiggles
enemy.boss.kkobul_king.desc: Squiggles balled up in marker and put on a crown. Scatters big eraser crumbs.
enemy.boss.shroom_queen.title: Queen of Glow Spores
enemy.boss.shroom_queen.desc: Paints the board with highlighter and spreads poison spores.
enemy.boss.shroom_queen.gimmick: Matches on cells the queen painted deal ×1.5
enemy.boss.kkaksae.title: Inkcrow Lieutenant
enemy.boss.kkaksae.desc: A magpie who nets your items and hides them under sticky notes.
enemy.boss.kkaksae.gimmick: Every 3 notes peeled, the magpie fumbles and attacks later
enemy.boss.galpil.title: Boss of the Inkcrow Gang
enemy.boss.galpil.desc: Calls in grunts and tapes up ink barrels. Runs off before losing.
enemy.boss.galpil.gimmick: Peeling tape spills the barrels on the crow
enemy.boss.bookworm.title: The Archive Muncher
enemy.boss.bookworm.desc: Chews through books and drips ink. Hides inside a book when hurt.
enemy.boss.bookworm.gimmick: When it hides, clear 4 ink to drag it out
enemy.boss.nightmare.title: Scribble in a Dream
enemy.boss.nightmare.desc: Puts friends to sleep and ties them to dreams with tape.
enemy.boss.nightmare.gimmick: Every 2 tapes peeled wakes a friend
enemy.boss.clock.title: Scribble on the Clock Hands
enemy.boss.clock.desc: Rewinds time to steal gauges, and keeps getting faster.
enemy.boss.clock.gimmick: Every 6 cells highlighted slows the clock
enemy.boss.gongnan.title: Clean Slate Officer
enemy.boss.gongnan.desc: A snowy owl who whites out records and your buffs.
enemy.boss.gongnan.gimmick: Peeling sticky notes hurts the owl
enemy.boss.sujeong.title: Clean Slate Officer
enemy.boss.sujeong.desc: A white goat who tapes over the board with a correction-tape hammer, then hides behind it.
enemy.boss.sujeong.gimmick: When the goat hides, peel 4 tapes to drag it out
enemy.boss.rainbow.title: Crayons All Mixed Up
enemy.boss.rainbow.desc: A scribble that changes color every phase. Bring friends of many types.
enemy.boss.whale.title: Stain of the Diary Sea
enemy.boss.whale.desc: An ink whale that swallowed pieces of the child's diary. Shakes the board with waves.
enemy.boss.malkkeum.title: Head of the Clean Slate Order
enemy.boss.malkkeum.desc: An ermine who covers the board and your friends in white paper, then dances at the end.
enemy.boss.malkkeum.gimmick: Peeling sticky notes hurts the ermine
enemy.boss.gugim_ball.title: The Crumpled First Drawing
enemy.boss.gugim_ball.desc: A paper ball with crayon showing through. One eye peeks out of the creases.
enemy.boss.gugim.title: The Paper Dragon
enemy.boss.gugim.desc: Hurt at being thrown away, it wants to crumple the whole notebook. Its type changes every wave.
cur.coin.desc: Earned by clearing stages. Spend on upgrades, capsules, and furniture.
cur.stardust.desc: Spend on Sparkle Draws and costumes.
cur.heart.desc: You lose 1 when you leave a stage uncleared. One refills every 20 minutes.

store.subtitle: Sticker Match-3 Fantasy RPG
store.short: Match stickers, lead a furry fantasy party, and erase the Scribble Demons!
store.promo: A match-3 RPG where a sticker company in a notebook's margin wipes out scribbles. Short guarantees, and hearts are never sold.
store.intro:
A sticker company in the corner of a notebook just woke up!
Angry scribbles are smudging every page.
Gather Grenn the wolf swordsman and friends, and match-3 the scribbles away.
store.feature1: Match to attack! Wipe out scribbles with Erasers, Pushpins, and Crayons
store.feature2: A capybara shield guardian, an axolotl water mage… 25 one-of-a-kind animal friends
store.feature3: 300 puzzle stages + raids + a new Daily Challenge every day
store.feature4: Decorate the company's Guild House with furniture stickers
store.feature5: Our promise: guaranteed featured friend at 70 draws, no hearts for sale, ads only when you want them
